purpose: Saved evidence for initial organism-evaluator calibration; no new simulation or field analysis.
reading_limits: Colors identify activator fields, not species.
Detector interior numbers are within-frame quality ranks, not tracked individual identities.
The t750 image is one snapshot; it cannot establish persistence.
The time-sampling image shows separate P7 snapshots at25,250,750 and per-frame score traces. Repeated enclosure detection does not establish survival of the same enclosure or its contents.
The legacy morphology score does not establish physical confinement, active maintenance or organism status.
